title: Kagamine Rin — Sparkling Performance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: One, two, and... Cute pose♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Phew...
I need to work harder for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is it possible to make this part cuter, though?
The pose just now wasn't very striking at all... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Someone's hiding over there?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In that case...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: One, two, three, four, turn here, and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wah?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ouch... Ugh, that really hurt!
I think I injured myself!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: H-Hey! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Aha!
Now I've caught you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were looking at me practicing just now, right? Why were you hiding, though?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I-I didn't want to interrupt you when you were practicing. Anyway, how's your injury? Does it still hurt?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Nope! I'm fine.
I was just pretending.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Pr-Pretending?! Oh, you...
You scared me out of my wits! Thank goodness you're okay.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha, sorry about that.
I'm just happy that you're visiting again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, right. I came here to talk to you about something.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? What about?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: About my future plans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've decided to continue pursuing the path of an idol.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? Really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. Minori said something that struck me. She said she would stick to the path she'd chosen without any regrets, come what may.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want to have that mindset too. I want to keep walking on the path I'd chosen, just like what I'd been determined to do when I first decided to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So...I'm going to give it another go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright! You have my support, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori wasn't the only one to make me think this way. Your encouragement really motivated me too, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why I wanted to come here to let you know about it! And express my gratitude, too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, if you're really grateful, come practice with me♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Practice with you?
Of course I'd be happy to!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! So there's this pose in the middle of the routine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, yes. The pose you were practicing just now. It did look a little out of place, like there's something lacking...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yes, I know...
What do you think I should do about it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about...something like this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Bring your hand up to your face, lift your leg up like this, put on a smile and...pose!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That looks so cute!
Yes, I think I'll try that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, it's a move from the time when I was still an idol, so it may be a little old-fashioned...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I don't think so! I think it's super cute!
Okay, I'm going to try it now♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm, I'm shorter than you, so I'll need to make my movements look bigger...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're always so serious about your performances.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I could feel it back when you were trying to cheer me up and right now as well. You're always giving it your all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? I mean, of course I am!
I'm an idol, after all!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want to lift up the spirits of everyone who comes to watch me perform! Even my best effort may not be good enough!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, you're right.
That's what being an idol is all about!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I'll share with you the secret to doing this pose well! Your fingers on this hand should be here... Just a little bit more.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! You noticed something so small?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! This is the best angle to place your fingers for the cutest pose! And that cute pose will bring the best encouragement to everyone watching!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Encouragement to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great! I'll master this pose if it's the last thing I do!
